stories.headline: Evenepoel wins a fourth straight world time trial title
stories.summary: Remco Evenepoel of Belgium has won the men's individual time trial at the Road World Championships in Montreal, Canada. He is the first man to win four consecutive titles in the event. The ride also equals the joint record for the most titles, held by Fabian Cancellara and Tony Martin.

stories.headline: Turf at 157 degrees as heat settles over Nashville
stories.summary: The artificial turf at Nissan Stadium in Nashville, Tennessee, reportedly reached 157 °F during the Tennessee Titans match against the Philadelphia Eagles. That is about 69 °C. Air temperatures at the time were approximately 95 °F.

stories.headline: Singapore sets fines for eating on public buses
stories.summary: Singapore's Land Transport Authority has introduced fines of up to S$500, about US$390, for eating on public buses or placing feet on seats. Severe cleanliness or safety violations can incur penalties of up to S$5,000, about US$3,900.

stories.headline: A scrap in a Utrecht library turns out to be The Odyssey
stories.summary: A fragment of parchment was hidden among a collection of early Christian manuscripts from Egypt, stored within the library of Utrecht University. Mark de Kreij, of nearby Radboud University, recognised it as an excerpt from Book 12 of The Odyssey. Only about 30 pieces of the poem have been found that date to the third or fourth century.
